📖 How to use

  1. Press Start — the 60-second timer begins.
  2. Type the answer and press Enter.
  3. Chain correct answers to raise the difficulty level.
  4. Wrong answers reset your streak — keep it alive!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which operations appear?

Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with whole-number answers.

How does difficulty ramp up?

Every 5-in-a-row streak raises the level: bigger numbers, times tables, division, then negatives.

How is scoring calculated?

Each correct answer scores 10 × your level; a wrong answer resets the streak.

How long does a round last?

You get 60 seconds from pressing Start. Answer as many as you can!
